input: Input domain: integer level from 0 through 2. Rules: R1: if level=0, action is HOLD. R2: if level>0, action is CONTINUE. Missing level has action REQUEST_VALUE. R1 has precedence over R2. Boundary values are 0 and 2. Time budget: 3 minutes; each designed case costs 1 minute; prioritize boundary cases.

cases.boundary_rationale: Exercises the lower boundary and equality at zero.
Exercises explicitly defined missing input behavior.

expected_artifact.coverage_summary: All two condition branches and the explicit missing-value branch are represented by synthetic cases.
boundary_notes: Level 0 tests equality and the lower boundary; level 2 tests the upper boundary.
